scope: High-contrast colored surface proxies under the sampled Gazebo camera/material/light conditions. Low-contrast defects and real-factory realism are unvalidated.
rationale: The r2 failed dent ring was correctly rendered but its raw channel delta14 was below the fixed >20 pixel validation threshold; ring geometry was not missing or oversized.
mapping: Each primitive source RGB / shared raw palette maximum .65 * (min(product RGB) - configured minimum gap) * scene color scale. Original primitive color ordering/hue and all geometry/nuisance schedules are retained.
exception_policy: Unsupported product/raw material domains fail acquisition; no scene resampling or outcome-dependent exception.
validation_required: New source/config/plugin fingerprint and new DATA_DIR
One fixed normal counterpart for every defect; failed pair stops acquisition without retry
Independent byte/pixel/label audits of all raw pairs
Separate disclosure diagnostic of the predetermined r2 failed scene under this global mapping
